name: Muse Spark Open
short: Meta's open-weight MoE foundation model (816B total / ~42B active, released Oct 2026 by Meta Superintelligence Labs) for agentic coding, developer workflows, and long-horizon repository tasks.
modalities: Text, code, image, video, audio in; text, JSON out
pricingNote: Free open-weight checkpoint (BF16/NVFP4); hosted serving via OpenCode Zen or self-hosted compute
freeTierNote: Free open-weight weights on Hugging Face (`meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B`); self-host at $0 license cost.
standout: Premier self-hosting autonomy: a frontier-grade open-weight MoE with a full 1M context window and verified long-context retrieval.
tradeoff: Open-weight serving still trails closed-frontier flagships on the top agentic/coding leaderboards.
